notes.title: VR Forever is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45466109/3b5684f33c6aa6b6e50a4bd98fe9af3cc24dd4d4.png[/img]

It’s time everyone!

The first edition of VR Forever is live!

[b][h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VRForeverFestival2025]VR Forever Steam Festival[/url][/h1][/b]
Over 130 games are taking part in this online festival that includes brand new games, demos and deep discounts on the best Steam VR has to offer. 

We are excited to announce the winners of the VR Forever Awards as well: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=steXbI-9ufo

With all that, enjoy the festival, play the games, leave a review, wishlist, increase your backlog and support the developers. 

VR Forever!
